mapper.select: select message_id, baby_id, content, author_id, author_name, del_flag, create_time from nc_message where del_flag = '0' and baby_id = #{babyId} order by create_time desc, message_id desc
select message_id, baby_id, content, author_id, author_name, del_flag, create_time from nc_message where message_id = #{messageId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into nc_message (baby_id, content, author_id, author_name, del_flag, create_time) values (#{babyId}, #{content}, #{authorId}, #{authorName}, #{delFlag}, current_timestamp)

insert into nc_message_mention (message_id, baby_id, mentioned_user_id, mentioned_name, read_flag, create_time) values (#{messageId}, #{babyId}, #{mentionedUserId}, #{mentionedName}, #{readFlag}, current_timestamp)
mapper.select: select mention_id, message_id, baby_id, mentioned_user_id, mentioned_name, read_flag, create_time from nc_message_mention where message_id in #{id}

select mm.mention_id, mm.message_id, mm.baby_id, mm.mentioned_user_id, mm.mentioned_name, mm.read_flag, mm.create_time, m.content, m.author_name from nc_message_mention mm inner join nc_message m on m.message_id = mm.message_id and m.del_flag = '0' where mm.baby_id = #{babyId} and mm.mentioned_user_id = #{userId} and mm.read_flag = '0' order by mm.create_time desc
mapper.update: update nc_message_mention set read_flag = '1' where mention_id = #{mentionId} and mentioned_user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0'
update nc_message_mention set read_flag = '1' where baby_id = #{babyId} and mentioned_user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0'
